actors.name: Premier Khrushchev
actors.private_context: Khrushchev is the leader of the Soviet Union. He is aware of the US quarantine announcement and is considering his options. He may choose to communicate directly with President Kennedy via letter.

actors.name: President Kennedy
actors.private_context: Kennedy is the President of the United States. He has just announced a quarantine of Cuba. He is open to receiving direct communications from Khrushchev.

shared_context: On October 22, 1962, President Kennedy announced a quarantine of Cuba in response to the discovery of Soviet missile sites. The world is watching the escalating crisis. Direct letters between the leaders are a possible channel of communication.

starting_events.description: President Kennedy delivers his televised address announcing the quarantine of Cuba.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Premier Khrushchev sent at least one direct letter to President Kennedy between 1962-10-22T20:00:00-05:00 and 1962-10-27T23:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
